summary: Completed testing of drag-and-drop functionality for media assets in Clara Dashboard. Fixed a critical backend bug where moving assets to root (folder_id=null) was not working. All 7 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing confirmed drag handle visibility, folder highlighting, and toast notifications work correctly.

fixed.issue: Setting folder_id to null was not working - assets could not be moved back to root
fixed.fix: Changed update_dict logic from filtering out None values to using model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

critical_code_review_comments: DraggableAssetCard component properly wraps asset cards with drag handle
DroppableFolderItem and DroppableAllFiles components handle drop targets
Visual feedback (orange ring highlight) works on drop targets during drag
Toast notifications display correctly for both 'Asset moved' and 'Asset moved to root'
Backend fix applied: exclude_unset=True allows explicit null values for folder_id
seed_data_creation: Used existing asset (24.png) and folder (Social Club) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag-and-drop for media assets is fully functional. Key components: DraggableAssetCard (wraps asset cards), DroppableFolderItem (folder drop targets), DroppableAllFiles (root drop target). Backend endpoint PUT /api/media/{id} accepts folder_id (string or null) to move assets between folders.

media_library_page_load.details: Page loads with folder sidebar, All Files option, and asset cards

drag_handle_visibility.details: GripVertical icon appears on hover over asset card (top-left corner)

drag_to_folder.details: Dragging asset to folder updates folder_id and shows 'Asset moved' toast

drag_to_root.details: Dragging asset to 'All Files' sets folder_id=null and shows 'Asset moved to root' toast

folder_highlighting.details: Orange ring highlight appears on drop targets when asset is dragged over

toast_notifications.details: Toast notifications appear for successful moves

backend_move_to_folder.details: PUT /api/media/{id} with folder_id correctly updates asset

backend_move_to_root.details: PUT /api/media/{id} with folder_id=null correctly moves asset to root (FIXED)

bug_fix_applied.description: Fixed backend bug where folder_id=null was being filtered out
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Line 164 in media.py used `if v is not None` which filtered out explicit null values
bug_fix_applied.solution: Changed to `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` which only excludes fields not explicitly set
bug_fix_applied.impact: Assets can now be moved back to root (All Files) via drag-and-drop
